expected: Room cards show the all-in total for the current meeting setup (room + projector + service) before a meeting name is entered, so Willow ($245) ranks below Atlas ($280); entered meeting name is kept when switching rooms. Prices, capacity, projector state and saved reservations are unchanged; the quick home-cards to details to review to confirmation path stays without a mandatory planning step.

criteria.description: On home and room-list cards, the prominent price for each room equals its review total for the current setup (Atlas $280, Willow $245 for 12 people with projector) with a visible all-charges-included label and breakdown, not the hourly room rate alone.
criteria.source: finding-49a51ebc-1ed6-4bfc-9fe2-e495e5786cfc-0 (observation: Atlas $220/h vs Willow $235/h but $280 vs $245 totals; expected: judge suitability from full cost)

criteria.description: Entering a meeting name, going back to choose another room, and selecting the other room keeps the entered name (no retyping), and review still confirms with correct room and total.
criteria.source: finding expected repair acceptance (preserve entered meeting details when switching rooms) and persona expectation to keep entered details

criteria.description: Room prices, fees, totals, capacity filtering, projector selection and the confirm-to-reservation flow are unchanged: Atlas totals $280, Willow $245, quick path intact, no mandatory planning step, no charges removed.
criteria.source: charter gather-book-room v1 success criteria (preserve factual prices, capacities, existing successful booking paths) and finding expected preserve clause

limitations: Only the observed one-hour, 12-person, projector-required configuration with the two visible rooms was verified from screenshots and code reading; other dates, durations and group sizes were not checked.
No browser retest or automated tests were run in this session (shell execution disabled); correctness rests on code inspection against the recorded $220+$35+$25=$280 and $235+$0+$10=$245 fixture.
preserve: Current quick path from home room cards through meeting details and review to confirmation with no mandatory planning step
Room prices, capacity, selected projector, fee breakdown and valid saved reservations (Atlas $280 total, Willow $245 total)
Existing visual style, layout and accessibility landmarks (no new controls or navigation)
problem: Comparing rooms by the listed hourly rate ($220 Atlas vs $235 Willow) reverses the true budget ranking ($280 vs $245 all-in); the total only appears at review, and going back to try the other room discards the entered meeting name.
title: Show all-in totals on room cards and keep meeting name
